name: @swimmingliu/autovpn
description: npm wrapper for the AutoVPN headless CLI

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-web-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs test/doctor/*.test.mjs test/jobs/*.test.mjs test/pool/*.test.mjs test/pipeline/*.test.mjs test/runtime/*.test.mjs test/server/*.test.mjs
